title: Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 11.0.0-beta before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in a Selling module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including portal users or those without assigned roles, to access Loyalty Program terms of other customers by sending crafted requests referencing out-of-scope records.
